text:
taylor_recruiter: Quick heads-up — Priya K (SRE candidate) pushed her flight, now lands 12:30p PT. She's scheduled for a 1:00pm onsite panel (system design) + 3:00pm coding. We need to either move the 1pm panel to 2pm or swap in a local panelist. Also scribe (maya_k) might be remote for the 1pm slot. Can people confirm availability? Need final schedule by EOD and debrief captured within 24h.
interview-bot: Calendar tentative: updated event 1:00pm → 2:00pm (pending panel confirmations). Invite sent to panel; will auto-assign scribe if confirmed.
emily_ops: I can cover scribe live in-room for 1–2pm if we keep 1pm, but I need AV and a laptop for live notes. Happy to swap with maya if she prefers remote.
alex_g: I can swap into the 2pm panelist slot (live coding at 3pm stays). If we must move system-design later, I'd rather keep coding at 3pm. Otherwise ok to shift 1→2.
maya_k: I can remote-scribe for 1pm if needed, but prefer to be in person for at least one loop. Also quick rubric q: are we using the revised weights from last quarter or the old ones?
sasha_ml: Use the revised rubric (launched Q4). Breakdown below — copy/paste to the debrief template so reviewers are aligned.
```
Rubric (current):
- Problem framing: 20
- Technical approach / system design: 35
- Implementation + correctness: 30
- Communication & collaboration: 15
Total: 100
```
emily_ops: Thanks — I'll paste that into the shared doc. Quick AV note: room B has flaky HDMI at the moment, recommend reserving room A. @facilities please confirm.
interview-bot: Scribe assignment: pending. If scribe doesn't confirm within 15m, auto-assign to emily_ops.
alex_g: Confirmed 2pm for system design. I can keep coding at 3pm. :thumbsup:
maya_k: I confirm remote scribe for 1pm if that helps. Will take notes in the shared template (link: https://docs.example.com/sre-eval-template). Will submit feedback within 24h.
taylor_recruiter: Awesome — locking 2:00pm for the panel (moved from 1). @emily_ops will be assigned as backup scribe, @maya_k remote scribe. Folks: please add any outlier concerns in the thread. Reminder: feedback must be in the template within 24h or it gets escalated to hiring lead for capture. Thanks all. :pray:
